items.name: Finset.lt_inf'_iff
items.type: {α : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_5} [LinearOrder α] {s : Finset ι} (H : s.Nonempty) {f : ι → α} {a : α} : a < s.inf' H f ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, a < f i

items.name: Finset.inf'_lt_iff
items.type: {α : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_5} [LinearOrder α] {s : Finset ι} (H : s.Nonempty) {f : ι → α} {a : α} : s.inf' H f < a ↔ ∃ b ∈ s, f b < a

items.name: Finset.inf_le_centerMass
items.type: {R : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_5} {α : Type u_7} [Field R] [AddCommGroup α] [LinearOrder α] [Module R α] [LinearOrder R] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] [PosSMulMono R α] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → α} {w : ι → R} (hw₀ : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) (hw₁ : 0 < ∑ i ∈ s, w i) : s.inf' ⋯ f ≤ s.centerMass w f

items.name: Finset.exists_mem_exists_mem_inf'_card_lt
items.type: {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α] {f : α → Finset β} (h₁ : s.Nonempty) (h₂ : ∀ j ∈ s, 0 < (f j).card) (h₃ : (s.biUnion f).card < s.card) : ∃ a ∈ s, ∃ x ∈ f a, (s.inf' h₁ fun j => (f j).card) < {j | j ∈ s ∧ x ∈ f j}.card
